contract.ownership: Existing IMU worker is sole I2C owner. Route configures PA31 passive GPIO input/no pull only after explicit command. No MCU IRQ, AON, KEY, display event, extra worker/timer or persisted setting. Input remains passive after stop, with no background pin polling.
contract.routing: Save CTRL4; verify original|20h. Route-only frames read INT1_CTRL/INT2_CTRL/MD1_CFG/MD2_CFG and require all four zero at begin and poll; do not overwrite them on a wrist fault. Ordinary start never configures PA31 or writes CTRL4.
contract.frames: Ordinary frame transfer maskfff; route adds1000/2000/4000/8000 for the four other routes, allffff. CTRL4 bit800. GPIO valid bits0/1 independent of I2C. Two raw levels immediately bracket SOURCE read; timestamps are before GPIO callbacks. No settle delay or physical release latency claim.
contract.event: Cache last configuration-valid, in-budget bit0 frame; later empty polls and stop preserve it. Expired/cancelled/invalid frames never count or replace event. Before/after source reads still clear latches. No gesture-rate claim.
contract.cleanup: Restore/readback CTRL4 plus original PULSE/TAP after disabling wrist and clearing source; do not reset native count or rail. Unknown bank blocks user aliases. Failed cleanup retains changed/FAULT/IDLE and invalidates shared daily reading until explicit cleanup. After-only telemetry failure does not restore active ownership.
contract.budget: At most12 I2C reads ordinary /16 plus2 GPIO reads route frame; each I2C retains50ms timeout; cancellation/deadline includes remaining whole frame.100ms is requested wait, not exact period. ARM wrist text1894B; state292B/cache260B; worker stack6144B unchanged, peak not measured.
